member.name: T:Althea.GeneralSolvers.Krylov.RestartStrategy
member.summary: The indicates which strategy shall be adopted by the thick restart Krylov subspace algorithms.
member.remarks: Other non built-in strategies are possible and they work as long as there exists implementation supporting them.

member.name: F:Althea.GeneralSolvers.Krylov.RestartStrategy.Naive
member.summary: The naïve strategy which only preserve the lowest Ritz eigen-pair and converged ones.

member.name: F:Althea.GeneralSolvers.Krylov.RestartStrategy.IndexBased
member.summary:
Based on the index of Ritz eigen-pairs, preserve the smallest $k$ ones:
$$k=n_c+\min{\left\{n_{\mathrm{eig}},\left(p-n_c\right)\left(\frac{2}{5}+\frac{n_{\mathrm{eig}}}{10p}\right)\right\}}$$

member.name: F:Althea.GeneralSolvers.Krylov.RestartStrategy.CurrentResidualBest
member.summary:
Based on the residual of Ritz eigen-pairs, preserve the smallest $k$ ones:
$$k=\underset{i}{\mathrm{argmax}}\left( \left| s_{n,i} \right| < \max\left\{ \sqrt{\left| s_{n,n_{\mathrm{eig}}} \right|\max_{j}\left| s_{n,j} \right|},2\left| s_{n,n_{\mathrm{eig}}} \right| \right\} \right)$$

member.name: F:Althea.GeneralSolvers.Krylov.RestartStrategy.OneStepResidualImprove
member.summary:
Based on the improvement of residual of Ritz eigen-pairs of single iteration after the restart, preserve the smallest $k$ ones:
$$k=\max{\left\{n_{\mathrm{eig}},\frac{3p+2n_c}{5}\right\}}$$

member.name: F:Althea.GeneralSolvers.Krylov.RestartStrategy.WholeIterResidualImprove
member.summary:
Based on the improvement of residual of Ritz eigen-pairs of all iterations after the restart, preserve the smallest $k$ ones:
$$k=\underset{k}{\max}{\left(p-k\right)\frac{\lambda_{k+1}-\lambda_1}{\lambda_m-\lambda_1}}$$

member.summary: The heuristic used by Krylov-Schur algorithm to prevent stagnating
